1. High, correctness: [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go:34)
Issue: `hasCustomSSHProgram` is computed as `system || global || local` before precedence is applied, so a lower-precedence custom `gpg.ssh.program` can still disable signing even when a higher-precedence scope resets it to `ssh-keygen`.
Why: a repo-local override back to the default signer will still be treated as “custom”, so checkpoint signing is skipped when it should proceed.
Evidence: the effective config is merged with precedence at [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go:39), but the skip branch at [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go:51) uses the pre-merge OR result instead of the effective program. The added tests in [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner_test.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner_test.go:90) do not cover `global/system=custom` with `local=ssh-keygen`.
Suggested fix: resolve the effective `gpg.ssh.program` in precedence order (`local`, then `global`, then `system`) and only skip when that resolved value is non-empty and not `ssh-keygen`; add a regression test for the override case.

2. Medium, simplification: [cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/objectsigner.go:33)
Issue: `loadLocalConfig()` re-opens the repo and re-reads local Git config every time the object-signer factory is invoked.
Why: this adds repeated filesystem and config-parsing work to every checkpoint-sign attempt.
Evidence: `SignCommitBestEffort` calls `plugin.Get(plugin.ObjectSigner())` on each signing path at [cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/committed.go](/Users/pfleidi/entire/cli/.worktrees/fix/1password-commit-signing/cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/committed.go:1809), and go-git’s plugin registry executes the registered factory on each `Get`, not just once, as shown in the module’s `x/plugin/plugin.go`.
Suggested fix: cache the local config lookup inside the registered closure, or cache just the effective local `gpg.ssh.program` signal, so signer creation does not repeat repo discovery and config parsing on each call.
